Celebrate the beauty of togetherness with “Jeevan Sathi Saath Mein Rahna” from the 1986 Hindi film Amrit! Featuring the memorable voices of Manhar Udhas and Anuradha Paudwal, this classic Hindi film song brings the charm of 1980s Bollywood music to life. Starring Rajesh Khanna, Smita Patil, Zarina Wahab, and Shashi Puri, Amrit is a memorable part of Hindi cinema's musical journey.
